changes: Internal-Only ICT Grade Enrichment: Enhanced JobDetails engine to query careers.apple.com with authenticated session cookies, ensuring ground-truth ICT level (ICT4/ICT5/ICT6) extraction for internal-only roles.
Interactive Authentication Feedback: Added immediate visual feedback ('Authenticating...') and auto-focus for AppleConnect sign-in and re-authentication with graceful window closure handling.
Official Apple EngWeb & Tools.Apple.com Onboarding: Standardized official bundle identifier to com.apple.aoh.jobsmonitor with Hardened Runtime verification.
Production Packaging Engine: Integrated clean zero-metadata, symlink-preserving ZIP archiver and automated release tooling for Apple Software Signing Portal (SSP).
Legacy LaunchAgent Migration: Automated background migration from com.aoh.jobsmonitor to com.apple.aoh.jobsmonitor for seamless notification and startup persistence.

Deterministic Experience Level Classifier: Integrated Apple JobDetails API enrichment engine that extracts internal job grades (ICT5/ICT6/ICT4) and full minimum qualifications, replacing heuristic keyword matching.

Persistent Job Details Disk Cache: Added local job_details_cache.json store ensuring each role's ground-truth metadata is fetched only once with zero latency or rate-limiting overhead on subsequent scans.

Prioritized Seniority Overrides: Advanced title indicators (Principal, Senior, Staff, Lead) now take precedence over generic associate designations, fixing misclassification of roles like Principal Regulatory Associate.

Multi-Page Internal Role Aggregation: Headless AppleConnect engine now automatically fetches across Page 1 and Page 2 on careers.apple.com, doubling internal tracked role capacity from 19 up to 38+ roles to match the top-40 public quota.

Live AppleConnect Internal Role Extraction: Upgraded background engine to evaluate the live SAML SSO handshake and extract fresh React DOM job cards from careers.apple.com, ensuring internal listings always reflect the latest positions.

Extended VPN & Network Reconnection Timing: Increased macOS wake grace period to 35 seconds and background fetch timeout to 45 seconds to ensure Wi-Fi and corporate VPN tunnels establish routing before evaluating job checks.
Automatic Transient Network Retry: Added 6-second automatic route recovery for background fetches when corporate VPN tunnels are still negotiating DNS.

Interactive Custom Search URL Editor: Clicking the search (🔍) button in Preferences now opens a multi-line, scrollable editor supporting direct URL editing, clipboard paste, default reset, and browser testing.
Light Mode Sign-In Visibility: Replaced static views with dynamic frosted NSVisualEffectView and high-contrast label colors in AppleConnect sign-in window.
Normalized Button Proportions: Standardized Confirm Sign In and Save URL buttons to native macOS rounded bezel proportions with crisp white contrast.
Enhanced OAuth Redirect Handling: Implemented navigation policy delegates and non-blocking WebKit redirect frame error recovery (Code 102/204) for AppleConnect IDMS SSO handshake.
Offscreen Host Window Lifecycle: Embedded headless WebKit instance into an offscreen AppKit host window to ensure WebProcess prioritization during background token negotiation.

Extended Sleep-Wake VPN Debounce: Extended network reconnection debounce on wake to 10 seconds to allow corporate VPN tunnels and internal DNS routing to fully establish before running overdue checks.

Automated AppleConnect Silent Re-Authentication: Offscreen headless WebKit engine automatically performs background SSO handshakes and captures fresh session cookies when connected to the Apple internal network.
Zero-Friction Internal Mode Setup: Toggling Internal Mode in Preferences automatically checks network availability and authenticates without displaying manual login prompts.
Resilient Internal Polling: If an SSO token expires or is refreshed by AppleConnect, background checks silently re-negotiate authentication and immediately retry fetching internal roles.
Seamless Corporate Network Roaming: Gracefully transitions between Apple corporate network (VPN / Wi-Fi) and public networks without false error popups.
Guaranteed Public Fallback: If AppleConnect SSO session expires or returns 0 internal roles, the dashboard seamlessly displays all 40 public roles with a subtle, muted warning notice.
Persistent AppleConnect Cookie Engine: Implemented on-disk cookie persistence with extended 30-day longevity and automatic re-injection on launch and system wake.
Translucent Auth Guidance Overlay: Added a floating frosted-glass guidance banner in the sign-in window with responsive real-time page status feedback.
Sleep-Wake & Cache Protection: Added 3-second network reconnection debounce on wake and cache preservation so offline glitches never wipe dashboard data.
Dynamic Version Resolution: Standardized appVersion to load directly from bundle CFBundleShortVersionString with robust fallback.
Hardware-Accelerated Update Changelog: Replaced legacy text view with a silky smooth SwiftUI ScrollView supporting 120Hz ProMotion momentum scrolling.
Installer Modal Logo Fix: Resolved icon placeholder fallback so high-resolution Jobs Monitor brand logo renders cleanly in the drag-to-Applications window.
Complete Asset Distribution: Added direct packaging for AppIcon.icns, AppIcon.png, and logo-jobsmonitor.png across all installation channels.
Public Job Title Link Fix: Direct job title clicks in Public view now reliably route to jobs.apple.com instead of careers.apple.com.
Automatic Experience Level Detection: Classifies positions into Intern, Early (1–3 yrs), Mid (4–7 yrs), Advanced (7+ yrs), and Director based on job requirements and role seniority.
Muted Experience Badges: Displays detected experience levels cleanly beside the team category (e.g. Software and Services • Advanced).
Experience Filter Pills: Added one-click segment filters for All, Intern, Early, Mid, Advanced, and Director levels with real-time role counts.
Decluttered Dashboard Table: Relocated tags from the role title column into dedicated interactive portal action badges in the PORTAL column.
Apple-Style Group Vector Icon: Replaced generic globe emoji with a sleek vector group filled icon for public roles, filter pills, and action badges.
Dynamic Portal Action Routing: Bottom action button dynamically hints and routes to  Internal Jobs (careers.apple.com) or 👥 Public Jobs (jobs.apple.com) based on the active filter tab.
Minimalist Filter Navigation: Renamed Both / All tab to All for a cleaner segment bar.
Preferences SSO Status Synchronization: Added dynamic '⚠️ Authentication Session Expired' warning in Preferences to accurately reflect when an AppleConnect session requires re-authentication.
Unified About Window Typography & Dynamic Spacing: Adopted ClipLocal-standard 24pt bold header, vibrant colored SF Symbol badges, auto-measured vertical layout, and 26px bottom padding.
Signature Diagonal Corner Shine Icon: Updated Jobs Monitor app icon and assets with top-left and bottom-right corner shine accents.
120 FPS Native Update Changelog: Upgraded update dialog with trackpad-smooth AppKit native NSTextView scrolling.

Native Apple-Style About Window: Redesigned the About window into a sleek, full-size visual effect dialog with SF Symbol feature highlights and symmetrical pill action buttons matching Rec and ClipLocal.
Internal Careers Portal Route Fix: Resolved 404 page-not-found error in AppleConnect sign-in sheet by routing directly to active careers search URL.
Manual 'Confirm Sign In' Action: Added dedicated Confirm Sign In button to authentication window for instant session validation.
Active Internal Mode Indicator: Restored 'Internal Mode: Active ' in the menu bar for active internal sessions while keeping menu bloat-free for public users.
Strict SSO Token Verification: Enforced authentic AppleConnect session tokens (myacinfo) before enabling Internal Mode, eliminating false authenticated states on public devices.
Gated Internal Preferences: Locked the 'Enable Internal Mode' toggle so it automatically reverts to OFF if AppleConnect sign-in is unauthenticated or cancelled.
False Alert Prevention: Completely suppressed 'Session Expired' menu warnings when running in public-only mode.

Apple Employee Internal Mode (careers.apple.com): Added full support for internal AppleConnect SSO authentication via a secure embedded sheet, enabling seamless tracking of unlisted internal job postings.
Dual-Channel Job Aggregation: Automatically queries and merges both public (jobs.apple.com) and internal (careers.apple.com) portals with independent top-40 quotas per channel.
Internal-Only Tracking Preference: Added option in Preferences to monitor exclusively internal employee requisitions.
Interactive 3-Pill Filter: Segmented tabs for Both / All,  Internal (top 40), and 🌐 Public (top 40) roles with dynamic count badges.
Live Instant Search: Real-time search filter directly on the dashboard to quickly filter roles by title, department, or city.
3-Tier Badges & Action Buttons: Clean distinction between  Internal Only,  Internal + 🌐 Public, and 🌐 Public Only roles with dedicated Internal ↗ and Public ↗ portal buttons.
Mode-Adaptive Dashboard: Automatically hides internal filter controls when Internal Mode is disabled for public job seekers.
AppleConnect SSO Session Health: Actively monitors SSO cookie validity and provides quick re-authentication in the menu bar if expired.
Expanded 40-Role Capacity: Increased tracked role capacity from 30 up to 40+ independent active roles.
Preference Revert on Close: Unsaved checkbox changes in Preferences are discarded if closed or cancelled.
Smart Sleep/Wake Timer Evaluation: Fixed background timer reset bug where macOS sleep/wake cycles repeatedly delayed periodic checks.
Overdue Job Check Recovery: Automatically measures elapsed time on wake and executes overdue job checks immediately.
Custom Notification Sound Volume: Added 0%–100% volume slider with real-time percentage text and debounced sound preview.
Notification Style Preview: Added live preview button in Preferences to test System Banners and Mid-Screen Popups directly.
Expanded Active Roles: Multi-page search fetching now retrieves and displays up to 30 active roles on your dashboard.
Dashboard UI Polish: Renamed dashboard tab to JobsMonitor_dash.html, updated greeting, removed header subtext, and optimized table column widths to 65% for Role.
Added dual portal Careers ↗ button linking directly to internal company posting URLs.
Added strict newest-to-oldest posting date sorting across all parsed job roles.
24-Hour Update Check Rate-Limiting: Automatic background launch update check now respects a strict 24-hour rate limit so it checks at most once per day without pestering.
Fixed visual state glitch where 'Last Checked' menu item didn't update until manually clicked by saving state before rebuild and adding NSMenuDelegate live updates on menu click.
Fixed daily digest timer suspension on macOS system sleep by observing NSWorkspace wake notifications and adding periodic timer health checks.
Automatically open Jobs Monitor Notification settings on first launch.
Installer now directly downloads the latest source code instead of using base64 encoding.
Fixed an issue where the sitemap was not automatically updating.
Added Notification Style setting to select between System Side Banner (respects DND) and Mid-Screen Window Popup (bypasses DND).
Cleaned Preferences UI with interactive ❓ and ℹ️ info modals for Custom URLs and Notification Styles.
Added Location Intelligence Filtering for Country (e.g. India) and City search modes.
Fixed blue-tinted background in Preferences window — now uses correct neutral system grey in both Light and Dark mode.
Expanded check interval options to include 12 Hours and 24 Hours.
Simplified preferences UI labels for clarity.
Relocated alert dismiss and notification sound settings into a unified card.
Replaced time picker wheel with a text-based dropdown for daily popup schedule.
Smooth Update Window Scrolling: Introduced hardware-accelerated SwiftUI ScrollView changelog viewer for 60 FPS / 120 FPS ProMotion trackpad scrolling.
Real-Time Update Check: Purged URLCache and added cache-busting timestamp parameters for zero-delay update notifications.
Cumulative Release Notes: Update alert now parses and displays all unread changes since your current build.
75+ notification sounds & ringtones with instant audio preview.
Automatic Startup section redesign with power icon and Launch at Login.
Pixel-perfect 14px card spacing and uniform header alignment.
Default notification sound updated to Bulletin.
Personalized dashboard greeting using dynamic macOS account user first name.
Preferences UI contrast fix for Light Mode and Dark Mode.
Simplified Preferences labels and pixel-perfect day button alignment.
Short date and time timestamp for Last Checked status item.
Menu layout polish and 1-click in-app auto-update execution.
Auto-download installer from GitHub on Update Now click.
Install app to /Applications for Finder visibility.
Removed GitHub Repository button from About window.
Cleaned up Contact Developer button in About window.
Converted installer to native Bash script without Python dependency.
Added kernel-level single instance flock lock to prevent duplicate menu bar icons.
Added automatic Preferences window pop-up on first launch.
Redesigned Preferences window with 600px card UI and clean city preset titles.
Expanded live-validated search presets to 30 countries and 29 tech hub cities.
Applied Apple Monochrome terminal installer theme with step-by-step ClipLocal styling.
Renamed app cleanly to Jobs Monitor.
Added Check for Updates menu option with background version checking.
Added automated GitHub Release workflow (.github/workflows/auto-release.yml).
Added adaptive vector menu bar icon with clean outer handle geometry.
Added multi-location country & city preset support.
Added native macOS Preferences window with custom daily digest schedule.
Added Launch at Login integration via SMAppService and LaunchAgent.
Standardized bundle identifier to com.aoh.jobsmonitor.
Added standalone install-jobsmonitor.command installer.
